title: Chapter 554
text:
A new episode of the Galaxy Times was released.

As usual, the players on the various forums watched this episode excitedly.

Two familiar hosts appeared in front of the camera and said the familiar opening.

"Hello players, this is Galaxy Times, dedicated to sharing first-hand information about the game and protecting your gaming career," the male host said.

"Based on the reactions of our players' private messages, we have decided to cancel the joke segment. We are a serious news program, and we have always adhered to the principle of reporting with detailed content. We will never use our sense of humor to attract attention … Pfft." The female host solemnly read the script, and as she read, she laughed out loud.

"Be serious." The male host sat up straight and looked straight ahead. His lips did not even open when he spoke, as if the words were forced out of his throat.

Many of the audience were amused, and the bullet screen was filled with comments.

"Hey, what do you mean by canceling? This segment is supposed to be a cold joke segment!"

"Hahaha, this is even funnier than a cold joke!"

The program continued, and the female host said, "This episode was released two days late. The content was originally to sort out the main storyline missions of the various novice planets in Version 2.0, but due to the incident with Blue Star not long ago, we had to change the script. Alright, let's take a look at the content of this episode …"

This episode of Galaxy Times explained the main storyline of Version 2.0 of the various novice planets. At this stage, the main storyline of most of the novice planets was clear, and the players of these planets were participating in it.

However, Blue Star was an exception. The reason why the Galaxy Times changed the script was because the Mutation Disaster had suddenly ended, so they had to change the content they prepared.

The players of the other planets were happily going through the storyline, but the main storyline of the Blue Star players was completed early.

However, the players of the other planets were envious and jealous.

The last segment of the program was Blue Star.

"Before this, in Version 1.0, Blue Star was the only place where players came into contact with the galaxy. Let's make a comparison. Every novice planet has its own specialty, and Blue Star's specialty might be that they can enter the galaxy earlier.

"This time, Blue Star has ended the main storyline of the planet ahead of time. This also means that the players will enter the interstellar map earlier than the other novice planets in version 1.0. According to the storyline of Blue Star, the NPC guiding the players is the former Black Phantom … the current Black Star. This is a legendary figure. There are many ways to learn about his past deeds, so I won't waste time here. "

Although the main storyline of the planet had ended early, they could enter the galaxy as soon as possible. To all the players, this was much more important than the original main storyline of Version 2.0.

The Blue Star players were very happy, and the Chinese clubs were even happier. They had made the right choice in choosing Blue Star. They had entered the galaxy early and were ahead of the other clubs in all aspects.

"From Black Star's actions, the other novice planets will also have a guiding faction. We will focus on introducing the actions of Black Star and the Black Star Mercenary on Blue Star …"

The two hosts read the script and analyzed Han Xiao's actions during the Mutation Disaster from various angles. They then analyzed the strengths and weaknesses of the Black Star Mercenary faction and gave a very high evaluation.

According to the experience of the professional players under Black Star in version 1.0, the benefits of the Black Star Mercenary were many. Furthermore, it was a growing faction. This meant that the players' struggles for the mercenary group could increase the various values of the mercenary group and provide more benefits for the faction. Galaxy Times believed that this guiding faction would be a faction that could stay for a long time. It was even possible that the Black Star Mercenary itself was a hidden main storyline.

The Blue Star players had already known about this and did not have much of a reaction. On the other hand, the players of the other planets sighed and were envious. Why couldn't they meet such a good NPC?

"Not bad at all."

Han Xiao had also watched this episode. Galaxy Times had a lot of complicated content and was not like Pork Bun, who only collected material to attract attention. However, the audience of Galaxy Times was much wider, and they would only report on him if he did something that had a bigger impact. This had indirectly increased his fame and attracted many players from the other planets.

Closing the forums, Han Xiao's attention returned to what was before him. At this time, he was in the sanctuary area outside Base No.2. The refugees that Bennett had settled down were no longer just for shelter but for urbanization. Not long after the Mutation Disaster ended, some of the strong refugees had already started to make a living. They could no longer be called refugees but residents.

Han Xiao sat at a roadside stall. He had heard that the owner of this stall used to be a high-grade chef who had escaped to the sanctuary. Although the ingredients used were all cheap, the taste was very good. The pot of meat soup was bubbling, and the aroma filled the air. The chef was even using a spatula to cook the meat, and his wife was a helper. She was stir-frying the green vegetables, and the aroma of the food attracted the attention of many passersby.

There was a long queue in front of the stall, and there were people holding bowls and wolfing down the food, almost swallowing their fingers. In the past few months, almost no one had eaten a good meal, and it had been a long time since they had tasted oil. Although the dishes were simple, they were no different from delicacies. These people ate happily.

This street was originally a dirty refugee camp, but it was much cleaner now. The atmosphere was no longer oppressive, and the atmosphere was relaxed. Some of the refugees who had decided to stay had taken down their tents and started to build simple houses. The two sides of the street were like construction sites, and everyone was busy.

"Big sister, this is delicious."

On the opposite side of the small table, Aurora was holding a bowl and eating. Her cheeks were puffed up, and she looked a little like a squirrel.

Hella ate a few mouthfuls and stopped eating. She reached out to tuck Aurora's hair behind her ears and gently stroked Aurora's back, afraid that she would choke.

Han Technician was not so stingy as to go shopping alone. He had asked the two sisters to go out together to inspect the situation in the sanctuary and talk about the Dragon Emperor at the same time.

The Mutation Disaster had ended for some time, and the disaster of Blue Star had been resolved. The Godora fleet guarding outside the atmosphere had already left, but Nagojin had stayed behind to be in charge of communication.

Han Xiao estimated that the players had already gotten used to the ending of the Main Storyline, so he decided to wrap things up and bring the players away. Ames had instructed him to bring the two sisters to Floating Dragon Island, and he informed the two of them in advance. Hella and Aurora did not have any objections.

While eating, Han Xiao's thoughts drifted to Risda. Risda had infiltrated one of the motherships for a few days already, but he had not completely cracked the database.

However, according to the signal that Risda had sent, he should be done soon. As long as he cracked the database, he would be able to obtain the location of all the motherships. At that time, Dark-star would be finished.

Recently, it was reported that the situation of the other calamity planets had increased, and Godora's rescue team had suffered a setback. It seems like the infiltrators of Dark-star used equipment to find the Mutation Source and actively fed it energy to increase the growth rate of the Mutation Source.

Han Xiao pondered for a moment before shaking his head. Most likely, Godora's attention was no longer on disaster relief. They were just waiting for his intelligence to get rid of DarkStar once and for all.

Wiping his mouth, Han Xiao stood up and prepared to pay. The stall owner wiped his hands on his clothes and hurriedly declined.

"Your Excellency, you are our savior, and all of us owe you our lives. How can we take your money?"

The stall owner's attitude was firm, and the surrounding people also agreed.

Hearing that, Han Xiao did not insist and patted Hella's head. "Then, you can pay."

"Did I allow you to touch my head? Do you think I am Aurora? "

Hila slapped his hand away in annoyance and glared at him. She hesitated for a while before taking out her wallet.Du du …At this moment, his communicator suddenly rang. It was a message from Risda."I have successfully cracked the database and can locate the location of all the motherships of DarkStar. I discovered that one of the motherships is heading toward Planet Aquamarine. It is very close, and there are three Calamity Grade officers traveling together. Pay attention."Seeing the first half of the sentence, Han Xiao's expression was filled with joy. However, after reading the second half, his expression became serious.A mothership is heading toward Blue Star?The purpose was obvious. The three Calamity Grade officers of Dark-star were definitely not there for sightseeing!"Could it be that Dark-star wants to destroy the planet that has successfully resolved the disaster?"A thought flashed through Han Xiao's mind, and he instantly had a guess that was most likely the case.Most likely, part of the reason was to deal with him. Otherwise, there would be no way three Calamity Grade officers would be dispatched.Could it be that Dark-star had noticed his actions?Han Xiao cursed in his heart. Godora's fleet was not around, and his own fleet alone would not be able to stop a mothership.The situation was urgent!He immediately contacted Nagojin and asked for reinforcements."I have detected that a Dark-star fleet is approaching Blue Star. They are very likely to want to destroy this planet. Hurry and send reinforcements!""What?I will report it immediately! "Nagojin was shocked.It was currently the honeymoon period of their cooperation, and Godora would naturally come to help.Han Xiao did not stop there. He contacted Bennett and the Six Nations and asked them to immediately arrange for people to guide the citizens of the city into the underground air defense facilities to take refuge.Dark-star would launch a global attack. Without a fleet to protect the planet, it would be a hundred times more dangerous than the previous time. They would be like a young girl exposed in front of a group of burly men. They could only try their best to reduce their losses before reinforcements arrived.This was Blue Star's greatest danger. Dark-star was an enemy that this planet could not resist. If they were not careful, their civilization would be destroyed!Just like Sunil in the past."What's wrong?" Hella saw Han Xiao's expression and could not help but frown and ask."A fleet is coming to attack us. Don't stay here anymore. Hurry and take your sister to the base to take refuge. I will open the base's protective shield later," Han Xiao said quickly."Aurora, go back. I can stay here and help you," Hella said with a deep voice."Help my ass. This battlefield is still too early for you."Han Xiao was not polite at all. Facing three Calamity Grades, even he would feel immense pressure. If not for the two Molding Talents that he had recently obtained, he would not be willing to take the risk. Hella was still far from being qualified to participate in a battle of this level.Hella's face stiffened, and she gritted her teeth angrily. However, she knew that Han Xiao was not someone who liked to be stubborn. If he said that she could not do it, he would definitely be telling the truth. Without hesitation, she turned around and ran toward Base No.2 with her sister.With Han Xiao's current status, he could already command the entire Blue Star. When the Six Nations and Bennett received the news, they were all shocked and immediately mobilized the people to take refuge.The entire sanctuary's alarm went off, and the city became noisy and chaotic. Groups of residents were led to the air defense facilities.The residents on this street also hurriedly moved, and it was extremely crowded.Hu!Just as Han Xiao was about to head to Base No.2 to take charge of the overall situation, a whistling sound came from the sky.More than ten Dark-star assault spaceships entered the atmosphere and headed toward the sanctuary. Without saying a word, the spaceships' light cannons fired crazily. Laser beams hit the outskirts of the sanctuary, and dozens of explosions occurred in an instant.Boom boom boom!Flames and thick smoke rose into the sky. The sanctuary that was peaceful a second ago was engulfed in the flames of war in the blink of an eye!Not only the sanctuary, but at the same time, the Six Nations were also attacked by other Dark-star assault spaceships.Blue Star was attacked by the enemy!"How did they come so quickly?"Han Xiao's face was solemn. He knew that this was not good. He had only received the news a few minutes ago, and Blue Star had just started to mobilize the people to take refuge. The enemy had already appeared?Dark-star assault spaceships flew overhead, bringing with them a strong gust of wind. Han Xiao glanced at them, and his eyes suddenly narrowed.Yes, the mothership is not here. These must be the vanguard!"We have to shoot down these assault spaceships immediately!"Han Xiao quickly contacted the mercenaries in the base to activate the protective shield. At the same time, he activated the surface-to-air electromagnetic railgun and ordered Herlous and the other officers to take the assault spaceships that they had captured in the previous attack to deal with the Dark-star vanguard.The sanctuary had a protective shield, so the situation was slightly better than the Six Nations. The Six Nations needed emergency support.Just as he gave the order, Han Xiao suddenly sensed danger approaching. He quickly dodged, only to see a black arrow dozens of meters long stabbed into the ground where he was originally standing.Bang!The street cracked open!The next moment, the black arrow collapsed, turning into countless black particles that surrounded a figure in the sky.Ashes looked down at Han Xiao. He snapped his fingers expressionlessly.Pa!This attack is not aimed at me … Han Xiaoxin tensed up, and he quickly turned around. Behind him were the residents of this street, fleeing into the distance. The next moment, a portion of the fleeing people suddenly turned into a pile of dust. The stall owner's family was among them. One second, they were still running away, and the next second, they turned into dust.The people who were not hit collapsed to the ground. They were all scared out of their wits, and a warm feeling seeped out from their crotch.This time, Ashes looked down from above and spoke coldly."Do you remember me, Black Star?"'Damn it, this guy's Esper Ability is too terrifying for ordinary people. I have to hold him back!'Han Xiao frowned, retracted his gaze, stared at Ember, and said sarcastically, "You lost to me a few times, of course I remember you. Do you want to taste the taste of defeat again?"Hearing this, anger appeared on Ashes's face. But when he remembered that his mission was to force Black Star to stay and fight, his anger quickly turned into a sneer."Hehe, you think I'm here to deal with you this time?"Ashes looked up and looked into the distance. He saw the sanctuary city on fire, and the assault ships were constantly attacking. The streets were blasted into ruins, and waves of people were fleeing in panic.His eyes swept across the chaotic crowd and locked onto Hella and Aurora who were fleeing in the distance."I already know who you are. Those two women are your friends, right? Collect their corpses!If there are any left! "Ashes suddenly activated his Esper Ability and clenched his fist. 

Hila slapped his hand away in annoyance and glared at him. She hesitated for a while before taking out her wallet.

Du du …

At this moment, his communicator suddenly rang. It was a message from Risda.

"I have successfully cracked the database and can locate the location of all the motherships of DarkStar. I discovered that one of the motherships is heading toward Planet Aquamarine. It is very close, and there are three Calamity Grade officers traveling together. Pay attention."

Seeing the first half of the sentence, Han Xiao's expression was filled with joy. However, after reading the second half, his expression became serious.

A mothership is heading toward Blue Star?

The purpose was obvious. The three Calamity Grade officers of Dark-star were definitely not there for sightseeing!

"Could it be that Dark-star wants to destroy the planet that has successfully resolved the disaster?"

A thought flashed through Han Xiao's mind, and he instantly had a guess that was most likely the case.

Most likely, part of the reason was to deal with him. Otherwise, there would be no way three Calamity Grade officers would be dispatched.

Could it be that Dark-star had noticed his actions?

Han Xiao cursed in his heart. Godora's fleet was not around, and his own fleet alone would not be able to stop a mothership.

The situation was urgent!

He immediately contacted Nagojin and asked for reinforcements.

"I have detected that a Dark-star fleet is approaching Blue Star. They are very likely to want to destroy this planet. Hurry and send reinforcements!"

"What? I will report it immediately! "Nagojin was shocked.

It was currently the honeymoon period of their cooperation, and Godora would naturally come to help.

Han Xiao did not stop there. He contacted Bennett and the Six Nations and asked them to immediately arrange for people to guide the citizens of the city into the underground air defense facilities to take refuge.

Dark-star would launch a global attack. Without a fleet to protect the planet, it would be a hundred times more dangerous than the previous time. They would be like a young girl exposed in front of a group of burly men. They could only try their best to reduce their losses before reinforcements arrived.

This was Blue Star's greatest danger. Dark-star was an enemy that this planet could not resist. If they were not careful, their civilization would be destroyed!

Just like Sunil in the past.

"What's wrong?" Hella saw Han Xiao's expression and could not help but frown and ask.

"A fleet is coming to attack us. Don't stay here anymore. Hurry and take your sister to the base to take refuge. I will open the base's protective shield later," Han Xiao said quickly.

"Aurora, go back. I can stay here and help you," Hella said with a deep voice.

"Help my ass. This battlefield is still too early for you."

Han Xiao was not polite at all. Facing three Calamity Grades, even he would feel immense pressure. If not for the two Molding Talents that he had recently obtained, he would not be willing to take the risk. Hella was still far from being qualified to participate in a battle of this level.

Hella's face stiffened, and she gritted her teeth angrily. However, she knew that Han Xiao was not someone who liked to be stubborn. If he said that she could not do it, he would definitely be telling the truth. Without hesitation, she turned around and ran toward Base No.2 with her sister.

With Han Xiao's current status, he could already command the entire Blue Star. When the Six Nations and Bennett received the news, they were all shocked and immediately mobilized the people to take refuge.

The entire sanctuary's alarm went off, and the city became noisy and chaotic. Groups of residents were led to the air defense facilities.

The residents on this street also hurriedly moved, and it was extremely crowded.

Hu!

Just as Han Xiao was about to head to Base No.2 to take charge of the overall situation, a whistling sound came from the sky.

More than ten Dark-star assault spaceships entered the atmosphere and headed toward the sanctuary. Without saying a word, the spaceships' light cannons fired crazily. Laser beams hit the outskirts of the sanctuary, and dozens of explosions occurred in an instant.

Boom boom boom!

Flames and thick smoke rose into the sky. The sanctuary that was peaceful a second ago was engulfed in the flames of war in the blink of an eye!

Not only the sanctuary, but at the same time, the Six Nations were also attacked by other Dark-star assault spaceships.

Blue Star was attacked by the enemy!

"How did they come so quickly?" Han Xiao's face was solemn. He knew that this was not good. He had only received the news a few minutes ago, and Blue Star had just started to mobilize the people to take refuge. The enemy had already appeared?

Dark-star assault spaceships flew overhead, bringing with them a strong gust of wind. Han Xiao glanced at them, and his eyes suddenly narrowed.

Yes, the mothership is not here. These must be the vanguard!

"We have to shoot down these assault spaceships immediately!"

Han Xiao quickly contacted the mercenaries in the base to activate the protective shield. At the same time, he activated the surface-to-air electromagnetic railgun and ordered Herlous and the other officers to take the assault spaceships that they had captured in the previous attack to deal with the Dark-star vanguard.

The sanctuary had a protective shield, so the situation was slightly better than the Six Nations. The Six Nations needed emergency support.

Just as he gave the order, Han Xiao suddenly sensed danger approaching. He quickly dodged, only to see a black arrow dozens of meters long stabbed into the ground where he was originally standing.

Bang!

The street cracked open!

The next moment, the black arrow collapsed, turning into countless black particles that surrounded a figure in the sky.

Ashes looked down at Han Xiao. He snapped his fingers expressionlessly.

Pa!

This attack is not aimed at me … Han Xiaoxin tensed up, and he quickly turned around. Behind him were the residents of this street, fleeing into the distance. The next moment, a portion of the fleeing people suddenly turned into a pile of dust. The stall owner's family was among them. One second, they were still running away, and the next second, they turned into dust.

The people who were not hit collapsed to the ground. They were all scared out of their wits, and a warm feeling seeped out from their crotch.

This time, Ashes looked down from above and spoke coldly.

"Do you remember me, Black Star?"

'Damn it, this guy's Esper Ability is too terrifying for ordinary people. I have to hold him back!'

Han Xiao frowned, retracted his gaze, stared at Ember, and said sarcastically, "You lost to me a few times, of course I remember you. Do you want to taste the taste of defeat again?"

Hearing this, anger appeared on Ashes's face. But when he remembered that his mission was to force Black Star to stay and fight, his anger quickly turned into a sneer.

"Hehe, you think I'm here to deal with you this time?"

Ashes looked up and looked into the distance. He saw the sanctuary city on fire, and the assault ships were constantly attacking. The streets were blasted into ruins, and waves of people were fleeing in panic.

His eyes swept across the chaotic crowd and locked onto Hella and Aurora who were fleeing in the distance.

"I already know who you are. Those two women are your friends, right? Collect their corpses! If there are any left! "

Ashes suddenly activated his Esper Ability and clenched his fist.
